review: On his own, [Kurokumo Clan Captain] Gregor doesn’t do much of anything, with all around lackluster damage and just passable clashing capability. The debuffs he inflicts are also very forgettable as the Plus Coin Drop from his S3 is the only notable debuff from his entire kit. With [Kurokumo Clan Captain] Ishmael, he doesn’t get much better. While he does benefit from her support by gaining Unbreakable Coins and becoming immune to Stagger when Ishmael’s passive is activated but aside from there there’s absolutely nothing particularly notable about Gregor.
